verdict.rationale: Zero calls itself an AI email solution, and the founder describes in-product AI that auto-categorizes mail, summarizes threads, drafts replies and lets users chat with their inbox. The MCP docs back this with capabilities to ask questions about mailbox content and specific threads and to compose with AI assistance. Missing for 10: first-party docs on the in-app (not MCP) insights and suggestions UI, proactive insight or suggestion features beyond Q&A and summaries, and independent hands-on corroboration (the product is in public beta).
